summary: Two numbers, { x, y }, useful for screen or map positions. Arithmetic methods modify the vector and return it, so call clone() first if you still need the original.

x.summary: The first component. You can assign to it.

y.summary: The second component. You can assign to it.

add.summary: Adds another vector to this one.
add.example: const moved = new kcds.math.Vector2(10, 20).add(new kcds.math.Vector2(5, -5)); // Vector2(15, 15)
add.exampleCs: var moved = new Vector2(10, 20).Add(new Vector2(5, -5)); // Vector2(15, 15)

sub.summary: Subtracts another vector from this one.
sub.example: const delta = new kcds.math.Vector2(10, 20).sub(new kcds.math.Vector2(4, 8)); // Vector2(6, 12)
sub.exampleCs: var delta = new Vector2(10, 20).Sub(new Vector2(4, 8)); // Vector2(6, 12)

mul.summary: Multiplies both components by a number.

div.summary: Divides both components by a number (not 0).

dot.summary: The dot product with another vector.
dot.example: const facing = new kcds.math.Vector2(1, 0).dot(new kcds.math.Vector2(0, 1)); // 0: at right angles
dot.exampleLua: local facing = kcds.math.Vector2.new(1, 0):dot(kcds.math.Vector2.new(0, 1)) -- 0: at right angles
dot.exampleCs: var facing = new Vector2(1, 0).Dot(new Vector2(0, 1)); // 0: at right angles

normalize.summary: Scales this vector to length 1 (a zero vector stays zero).
normalize.example: const direction = new kcds.math.Vector2(3, 4).normalize(); // about Vector2(0.6, 0.8)
normalize.exampleCs: var direction = new Vector2(3, 4).Normalize(); // about Vector2(0.6, 0.8)

lerp.summary: Moves this vector towards a target: t = 0 stays, 1 reaches it.
lerp.example: const halfway = new kcds.math.Vector2(0, 0).lerp(new kcds.math.Vector2(10, 20), 0.5); // Vector2(5, 10)
lerp.exampleCs: var halfway = new Vector2(0, 0).Lerp(new Vector2(10, 20), 0.5); // Vector2(5, 10)

clone.example:
const start = new kcds.math.Vector2(1, 1);
const end = start.clone().add(new kcds.math.Vector2(2, 0)); // start stays Vector2(1, 1)
clone.exampleLua:
local start = kcds.math.Vector2.new(1, 1)
local finish = start:clone():add(kcds.math.Vector2.new(2, 0)) -- start stays Vector2(1, 1)
clone.exampleCs:
var start = new Vector2(1, 1);
var end = start.Clone().Add(new Vector2(2, 0)); // start stays Vector2(1, 1)
